items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: I didn't see him over there.

ctx.x: Buddy wasn't over there. Buddy Petit wasn't over there then, much. No. Bunk over there then, in Mandeville? Did you see Bunk over there?
I didn't see him over there. He was around the house. Yeah.
I know he went over there because he taught Tommy Ladner over there.

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: Bunk alright that was four really hot trumpet players see but every one of them played alright but they all played a different style

ctx.x: who do you think was a better trumpet player Keppard or Oliver oh

Joe Joe well yeah as I say you take Joe Freddie Keppard Manny Perez Bunk alright that was four really hot trumpet players see but every one of them played alright but they all played a different style so therefore you can't say nothing everybody in Chicago want to know who was the best of the players so they went to work and they got Joe was playing at the Royal Garden they went and got Manny Perez they got Joe and they got Freddie and they put them all over there to play one night?
